steps.instruction: Read the request and its one digest-frozen peer snapshot. Require the exact task set, child goals, owned scopes, coordinator done-when map, declared original session locations and repository boundaries. Do not accept messages or unbound locations as evidence.

calls.purpose: Read and hash the frozen peer snapshot.

produces: Frozen peer and coordinator obligation inventory.

steps.instruction: For each peer, read only its declared original live terminal session or verified close-success bundle. Verify exact frozen goal, solo topology, terminal state, each original goal ledger proof and accepted evidence. Treat ordinary task messages only as locators.

calls.purpose: Read original session records and evidence manifests.

steps.instruction: Resolve every declared repository boundary and verify its evidence at the exact current head with valid ancestry. Keep repository proofs separate; never union evidence from different heads into a delivery no peer produced.

calls.purpose: Read exact repository heads, ancestry and evidence paths.

steps.instruction: Reread the snapshot and evidence hashes, map every coordinator done-when line to one proved peer goal, and identify concrete missing, stale or mismatched proof without modifying any peer.
produces: Concrete failed-criterion feedback or passing review results.

steps.instruction: Write and validate the response with the portfolio report, observations and review results. A missing peer proof returns blocked or mismatch and is never inferred from peer status or conversation text.

calls.purpose: Present the exact peer-to-goal and repository proof map.
